title: Insufficient Calibration dead-end on G6
symptom: After fitting a new Dexcom G6 sensor and entering the calibration code, readings were inaccurate. After entering a calibration, no more readings were received, and the phone showed 'insufficient calibration' on the screen and under system status. The calibration button was disabled, and after trying 'Stop Sensor' -> 'Don't stop sensor, just reset calibrations', the calibrate option disappeared entirely.
cause: The thread suggests that xDrip does not work correctly with the Dexcom G6 on certain phones, possibly due to Bluetooth compatibility issues. The commenter opasha states that the issue can be resolved by disabling the 'Use the OB1 Collector' setting in G5/G6 settings, implying that the OB1 collector is the cause of the problem.
fix: Disable the 'Use the OB1 Collector' setting in G5/G6 settings, wait 5 minutes, and the sensor will be picked up. This workaround is also suggested for the classic 'stopped sensor' error.
evidence_quote: you need to disable in G5/G6 settings, "Use the OB1 Collector" - see my screenshot. Wait 5 min and it will pick up your g6 sensor guaranteed.
